nodes.description: Constructor of the Brainz ERC20 token; initializes name/symbol and the Rng state variable.
Public mapping(uint => uint) storing the last staking timestamp per Bit Monster tokenId, used for reward accrual.
Private Rng struct state used as the pseudo-random generator for the stake() game.
IBitMonsters reference set by setBitMonstersContract; used for ownership, indexing and monster data.
Admin-only function that mints count ether BRAINZ to an address.
Admin-only function that burns count ether BRAINZ from an address.
Iterates all Bit Monsters owned by msg.sender, computes rewards, updates tokenIdToTimestamp and mints the total.
Pure function computing the per-day reward rate of a Bit Monster from genesis/special/superYield flags.
View function returning pending BRAINZ for a tokenId based on elapsed days and rewardRate.
Admin-only function that initializes tokenIdToTimestamp for a newly staked Bit Monster.
Gamble function using the pseudo-random Rng to either mint 1.9x rounded-up BRAINZ or burn the stake.
Owner-only setter that assigns the external IBitMonsters contract address.
Library function producing a bounded pseudo-random uint using the Rng state and getEntropy.
Library function deriving entropy from block.coinbase and msg.sender (miner/sender controlled).
Library function creating a new Rng struct seeded with getEntropy().
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, reward enumeration and entropy.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used for staking registration and reward calculation.
Use of rn.generate(0,1) as a coin flip; randomness derives from block.coinbase and msg.sender and is predictable.
Mint of (count - count/10) * 1 ether inside stake(); arithmetic and supply-increasing mint guarded only by the weak RNG.
Burn of count * 1 ether from the staker inside stake() on the losing branch.
Recipient address parameter of adminMint.
Amount parameter of adminMint, multiplied by 1 ether.
Target address parameter of adminBurn.
Amount parameter of adminBurn, multiplied by 1 ether.
Token id whose rewards are computed in calculateRewards.
Token id being staked/registered in register.
Number of BRAINZ tokens the caller stakes in stake().
Bit Monster struct passed by value into rewardRate.
Inclusive lower bound passed to RngLibrary.generate.
Inclusive upper bound passed to RngLibrary.generate.
Rng struct (self) passed by value into RngLibrary.generate.
Accumulator of all rewards to be minted in claimBrainz.
Number of Bit Monsters owned by msg.sender in claimBrainz.
Per-token reward value returned by calculateRewards inside claimBrainz.
Loop index over the caller's Bit Monsters in claimBrainz.
Token id fetched via tokenOfOwnerByIndex inside the claimBrainz loop.
Elapsed whole days derived from block.timestamp in calculateRewards.
Bit Monster struct loaded from bitMonsters inside calculateRewards.
Modulo range (max - min) computed inside RngLibrary.generate.
Memory copy of the rng state used and written back in stake.
Return flag indicating whether the stake gamble was won.

edges.reason: msg.sender selects which Bit Monsters are enumerated and where claimed BRAINZ are minted.
msg.sender's balance is checked and used to fund/mint the stake outcome.
Claim bookkeeping computes the day boundary from block.timestamp.
Reward amount is directly proportional to elapsed block.timestamp days.
Registration timestamp is written from block.timestamp, anchoring future rewards.
claimBrainz reads and rewrites tokenIdToTimestamp to roll rewards forward.
calculateRewards reads tokenIdToTimestamp to compute elapsed days.
register checks and sets tokenIdToTimestamp for a token.
stake loads the rng state variable into memory before generating.
stake writes the advanced rng state back to storage after the draw.
The generated pseudo-random value becomes the new rng state via rng = rn.
getEntropy mixes msg.sender into the seed, letting the caller influence randomness.
setBitMonstersContract (owner-only) assigns the external bitMonsters reference.
claimBrainz uses bitMonsters for balanceOf and tokenOfOwnerByIndex.
calculateRewards reads monster data from bitMonsters.getBitMonster.
Minted stake winnings are credited to msg.sender.
Burned stake is debited from msg.sender.
adminMint authorization resolves through bitMonsters.isAdmin(msg.sender).
adminBurn authorization resolves through bitMonsters.isAdmin(msg.sender).
stake invokes the unsafe RNG draw to decide the outcome.
Winning branch (draw == 0) executes the mint of winnings.
Losing branch (draw != 0) executes the burn of the stake.
claimBrainz calls calculateRewards for each owned token.
calculateRewards calls rewardRate to price the per-day reward.
RngLibrary.generate calls getEntropy to advance the Rng state.
newRng seeds the Rng struct from getEntropy.
Constructor initializes the rng state variable with RngLibrary.newRng.

Monster struct local fetched from bitMonsters inside calculateRewards.

Return-value local set by the two branches of stake.
